pathways.evidence: Light is one of the crucial factors for the modulation of photosynthesis gene expression (18, 19, 42), and indeed, our data may indicate a reorganization of the photosystem I (PSI) and PSII complexes upon shifting to high-light conditions. (p6)
PMM1672 is an ortholog of a gene well studied in other cyanobacteria (27) that encodes a fatty acid desaturase (des9 and desC) (p8)
The absorption of blue-light and/or red-light photons by chlorophylls may ultimately induce alterations in the redox state of the photosynthetic electron transport chain (p7)
